svg.title: Gateman V1 verified circuit diagram
svg.desc: Physically verified wiring diagram for Gateman V1: ESP32-WROOM-32 brain connected to MFRC522 RFID reader via SPI, ESP32-CAM AI-Thinker via UART, and USB powerbank hub supplying both boards independently.
svg.text: Physically confirmed 2026-07-18 · continuity tested · no enroll button in this build

g.text: Supplies 5V USB independently to each board
NEPA outage bridge power · shared GND via USB commons
Both boards on separate USB ports — not from WROOM 3.3V pin
